app.title: Climbing Conditions
app.subtitle: Bouldering conditions from ECMWF forecasts and IRM/KMI observations
app.no_tips: No specific advice: conditions are unremarkable.
app.refresh_timeout: Still waiting. Check the Actions tab on GitHub.
app.token_label: GitHub fine-grained token (Actions: read & write, this repository only)
app.token_help: Stored only in this browser. Leave empty to disable the button.
app.age_old: Data from {time} ({age} old). Refresh before you go.
app.no_data: No data published yet. Run the “update-weather” workflow on GitHub.
app.provisional: IRM 10-min observations are provisional (not yet validated).
app.about: Generic advice for the region. It cannot see your crag's microclimate.
app.day_over: The climbing day is over: pick another day in the outlook.

tips.recent_rain: Recent rain: favour steep or overhanging, sunny, wind-exposed rock. Avoid shaded, tree-covered, sheltered or seepage-prone spots.
tips.drying_time: Rock should be dry enough in about {hours_to_dry} h (around {dry_at}), on sun- and wind-exposed faces first.
tips.not_drying: Rock is unlikely to dry within the forecast period in exposed spots; sheltered faces will take even longer.
tips.humid_still: Humid and still: look for higher, windier, more exposed spots. Avoid sheltered or low-lying areas and valley bottoms.
tips.strong_wind: Strong wind: favour sheltered or lower locations, out of the main wind.
tips.warm: Warm: favour shaded or north-facing aspects, and go early morning or late evening.
tips.cold: Cold: favour sun-exposed south- or west-facing aspects, around midday and afternoon.
tips.sun_aspects: Sunny spells: east-facing rock gets the morning sun, west-facing rock the afternoon sun.
